title: Safe actionable backend error banners
summary: Centralized WebView Local API error formatting and expanded launch backend-preflight blockers so API failures and launch-stop banners render specific, actionable, sanitized user-facing messages.
reason: Backend/API failures were thrown as plain Error messages, and launch backend-preflight startup alerts condensed blockers to a generic first-blocker/evidence sentence. Operators needed the popup itself to say what is wrong, how to fix it, and where to look when the backend cannot produce an automatic repair.
behavior_before: apiClient.js threw generic plain Error values for HTTP failures, timeout failures, invalid JSON, and network failures; raw backend strings could be surfaced directly in UI status rows. Launch startup alerts showed only the first blocked check name plus evidence, and autonomy pending-manifest blockers used generic manual-recovery wording.
behavior_after: apiClient.js throws categorized user-facing errors that identify the failed action, safe endpoint label, category, HTTP status/backend code when present, and a short next step while redacting or suppressing stack traces, raw SQL, paths, tokens, internal hostnames, and sensitive payload-looking details. Launch startup alerts now show explicit What is wrong / How to fix / Backend detail / Recovery route lines, and autonomy pending-manifest blockers name the invalid manifest evidence, selected recovery-plan route, repair dry-run path, and schema-reference fallback.
tests_added: Expanded tests/webview/test_webview_api_client_smoke.py coverage for validation, authentication/session, permission, not found, conflict, rate limit, timeout, network unavailable, server error, database/storage error, invalid JSON, and sensitive-detail redaction.
Updated tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static_shell.py static assertions for the sanitized shared API error formatter.
Added tests/python/desktop/test_autonomy_health.py coverage for untrusted pending manifest blocker message, row evidence, repair guidance, and selected recovery-plan request.
Expanded tests/webview/test_webview_launch_command_buttons_smoke.py coverage so the startup alert must include what-is-wrong, how-to-fix, backend detail, and recovery-route text.
manual_validation: FAIL unrelated/pre-existing: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static_diagnostics_reports -q failed on missing active-jobs wording assertion 'active/review=' outside this error-banner change.
rollback_plan: Revert the apiClient.js formatter changes, Diagnostics fallback wording, launch startup alert formatter, autonomy pending-manifest wording, updated tests, and refreshed summaries in this packet to restore the previous plain Error and first-blocker alert behavior.
